items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: Years later when Chauncey had his own band, Stan King played drums.

ctx.x: Were you in "When I Take My Sugar to Tea". One just started, just says yes, one says Stan King. So you never know.
And there was one, 'Concentrating on You', I think Connie alone, you're supposedly on that.
